feedback.description: Edit this into what you meant: fix wrong words, drop false starts, put things in order, fix grammar. Keep your own words and every idea you said. Kass uses it as an example on your next dictations right away, and the personal model trains on it while the app is idle. Everything stays on this device. Deleting a capture removes its corrections from future training.

modelPhases.waiting: Waiting for the next idle period.
modelPhases.preparing: Preparing the training and evaluation datasets.

modelPhases.waiting_idle: Waiting until recording and model work finish.
modelPhases.waiting_model: Download the selected refinement model before training can begin.
modelPhases.training: Training candidate model weights in the background.
modelPhases.activated: A validated model improvement was activated.
modelPhases.rejected: The candidate did not pass every quality and performance check. The current model was kept.

learning.description: The background job trains a personal refinement model and tests it on separate corrections and recorded audio. It also compares installed speech models. Only improvements that pass accuracy, speed and memory checks are activated. Recording takes priority, and updates can be undone.
learning.waiting: Waiting for the first background check.
learning.no_change: No new corrections passed the checks. More distinct examples may be needed.
learning.rolled_back: The previous correction version was restored. Withdrawn corrections will not be added again automatically.
learning.tooSlow: The candidate exceeded the speed limit and was not activated.
learning.failed: Could not check or update learned corrections. Try again.

review.title: Check this cleanup
review.rejectedTitle: Your words were kept instead of the cleanup

reasons.answered: The cleanup looked like a reply to what you said, not a cleanup of it.
reasons.dropped: The cleanup left out part of what you said.

reasons.name: The cleanup left out a name you said.

review.hint: If it's wrong, type what you meant under Teach so Kass learns it.

inspector.noCorrections: None yet. Alter the text to teach Kass.

reports.revealFailed: Couldn't show the report in Finder

contents.system: Kass's version, your macOS version, chip, memory and swap, and your model and feature settings

private.title: Never included

command.title: From Terminal or an AI agent

stats.noWeekendAny: No weekend dictation in this period

where.title: Where you dictate

length.title: How long you talk

empty.title: No dictation yet

version.title: Version

betaUpdates.title: Beta updates
betaUpdates.description: Get new features before they're public. Betas may have rough edges.
betaUpdates.leaving: You're on beta {{version}}. Kass moves to the next public release once it's newer.

server.title: Local server
server.description: Runs Whisper and Qwen3 on this Mac. Your voice and words never leave it.

restart.title: Restart Kass
restart.description: Restart the app and its local server. Any recording or task in progress will stop.

launchAtLogin.title: Launch at login
launchAtLogin.description: Start Kass in the background when you log in, so dictation is ready.
launchAtLogin.unavailable: Only the installed app in Applications can launch at login.
launchAtLogin.requiresApproval: Turned off in System Settings › Login Items.

shareUsage.title: Share anonymous usage stats
shareUsage.description: Once a day, send counts like dictations, words, time saved and speed, with your Mac's chip and which models you use. Never your words, audio or apps.

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.description: Capture from anywhere on your machine with a global shortcut.

globalShortcut.title: Global shortcut
globalShortcut.description: Dictate from any app, even when this window is closed.

inputDevice.title: Microphone
inputDevice.description: Choose which microphone Kass records dictation from.

pushToTalk.title: Push-to-talk
pushToTalk.description: Hold to record, let go to finish.

toggle.title: Hands-free
toggle.description: Tap to start, tap again to stop. Usually push-to-talk plus Space.

chordPicker.pttDescription: Hold the keys you want to use, then release and click Save. The right-hand modifier badge shows whether a key is the left or right variant.
chordPicker.toggleDescription: Hold the keys you want to use, then release and click Save. Pick something distinct from your push-to-talk chord.

preview.title: HUD preview
preview.description: What appears on screen while you're holding the shortcut.

soundCues.title: Sound cues
soundCues.description: Chime when recording starts and stops, and when a dictation is canceled or fails.

soundCueVolume.title: Sound cue volume
soundCueVolume.description: Plays the start chime when you let go of the slider.

copyToClipboard.title: Copy transcript to clipboard
copyToClipboard.description: The cleaned transcript lands on your clipboard when the capture finishes.

autoPaste.title: Paste at cursor
autoPaste.description: Types the refined text into the focused field. Needs Accessibility. Kass saves and restores whatever was on your clipboard.

voiceEdits.title: Voice edits
voiceEdits.description: Start with “fix that” or “fix” to change the text before your cursor: “fix that, Morgan not Megan”, “fix, it's Thursday”, “fix that, delete actually”, or spell the word out.

transcription.title: Transcription · Whisper
transcription.description: Pick which speech-to-text model runs on your captures.

model.title: Transcription model
model.description: Whisper runs entirely on your machine. Choose it in the Models tab.

language.title: Language
language.description: Auto-detect works for most captures. Lock it if you're always speaking the same language.

archive.title: Archive audio
archive.description: Keep the original recording alongside every transcript.

toggle.title: Use Kass's trained models
toggle.description: Kass ships cleanup models it trained on made-up examples, so your text reads well from your first take. Your Mac's own training builds on them. Turn this off to use the plain models.

voiceTraining.title: Voice training
voiceTraining.description: Kass trains its speech model on your own takes, with other people talking and busy rooms mixed in, so it follows your voice when it isn't quiet. Training runs while your Mac is idle, and a new version is used only when it makes fewer mistakes.
voiceTraining.needsTurbo: Voice training works with the Turbo transcription model. Choose Turbo in the Models tab to use it.

sounds.title: Background sounds
sounds.description: Recordings of people talking and of restaurants, offices and living rooms, mixed under your takes while Kass trains. A one-time download of about 0.6 GB. Nothing is uploaded.

takes.title: Your takes
takes.description: Clean takes Kass keeps to train on, up to 2 hours. Deleting a capture removes its take, and turning on Discard audio removes them all.

model.title: Voice model
model.active: Using your trained voice model since {{date}}.
model.lastPassed: Last training: mistakes with background talk and noise went from {{before}} to {{after}}.
model.lastKept: Last training: {{before}} → {{after}} mistakes with background talk and noise, so the current model was kept.

refinement.title: Refinement · Qwen3
refinement.description: Optionally run a local LLM over transcripts to clean filler words, punctuation, and self-corrections.

auto.title: Refine transcripts automatically
auto.description: Runs after every capture. You can still toggle between raw and refined in the Captures tab.

model.title: Refinement model
model.description: Larger models are slower but handle subtle self-corrections and technical vocabulary better. Choose it in the Models tab.

smartCleanup.title: Smart cleanup
smartCleanup.description: Remove filler words, restore punctuation, and apply spoken formatting such as new lines, paragraphs, and bullet lists without rephrasing.

punctuationStyle.title: Punctuation style
punctuationStyle.description: Casual joins related thoughts with commas and keeps run-on sentences the way you said them. Standard punctuates like written prose. Match my writing follows the habits Kass learned from you in Writing style.
punctuationStyle.learned: Match my writing · learned from you
punctuationStyle.learnedLocked: Match my writing · teach Kass first

selfCorrection.title: Remove self-corrections
selfCorrection.description: When you change your mind mid-sentence ("actually, no...", "wait, I meant..."), drop the retracted part and keep the final intent.

expressive.title: Write how it was said
expressive.description: Add "!" when you say something with energy, and draw out a word you stretch ("wayyy"). Kass keeps learning from your voice and edits while this is off.

preserveTechnical.title: Preserve technical terms
preserveTechnical.description: Keep code identifiers, command names, and acronyms exactly as spoken. Turn on when you dictate into a code prompt.

styles.title: Punctuation, filler and technical terms
styles.description: Each writing style has its own, so every app gets text written its way.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Captures are saved as paired audio and transcript files in your Kass data directory.

recordings.title: Delete voice recordings
recordings.description: Each recording is deleted as soon as its text is saved. Captures keep their text, but can't be played back.

retention.title: Keep history
retention.description: Older captures are deleted with their audio. Corrections, what Kass learned and your stats are kept.

confirm.title: Keep {{window}} of history?
confirm.description_one: {{count}} capture older than {{window}} will be deleted with its audio. Its corrections, what Kass learned from it and your stats are kept.
confirm.description_other: {{count}} captures older than {{window}} will be deleted with their audio. Their corrections, what Kass learned from them and your stats are kept.
confirm.unknown: Captures older than {{window}} will be deleted with their audio. Their corrections, what Kass learned from them and your stats are kept.

ask.title: Delete old captures?
ask.description_one: Kass now keeps {{window}} of history. {{count}} capture is older than that and would be deleted with its audio. Your corrections, the names it learned and your stats are kept.
ask.description_other: Kass now keeps {{window}} of history. {{count}} captures are older than that and would be deleted with their audio. Your corrections, the names they taught and your stats are kept.
ask.description_zero: Kass now keeps {{window}} of history. No captures are older than that yet. Your corrections, the names they taught and your stats are always kept.

folder.title: Captures folder
folder.description: Where capture audio and transcripts are stored on disk.

logs.title: Server Logs
logs.devHint: Server logs are only captured when the app manages the server process (production builds).

commandMode.description: Select text in any app, hold the command shortcut and say what to do with it: “make this more concise”, “translate to Spanish”, or a transform’s name. The rewrite replaces the selection, and the original stays in Captures. Rewrites run on the dictation cleanup model.

chord.title: Command shortcut
chord.description: Hold to speak an instruction for the selected text, let go to rewrite it.
chord.needsShortcut: Turn on the global shortcut in Dictation settings first.
chord.pickerDescription: Hold the keys you want to use, then release and click Save. Pick something distinct from your dictation shortcuts.
chord.taken: That shortcut already starts dictation. Pick different keys.

transforms.title: Transforms
transforms.description: Saved instructions. Say a transform’s name with the command shortcut (“polish this”), or run it on the selection from ⌘K.

dialog.description: The name is what you say to run it. The instruction is what it does to the selected text.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.instructionPlaceholder: Make this about half as long. Keep every fact and my tone.

features.title: Features
features.description: Everything Kass does besides hold and talk. Each one opens where you set it up or use it.

styles.title: Writing styles
styles.description: Casual in Slack, full sentences in Mail. Each app gets a style.

teach.title: Teach by replying
teach.description: Reply to a few messages out loud so Kass learns how you write.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.description: Names and terms Kass should always spell your way.

fixCapture.title: Fix a capture
fixCapture.description: Correct a dictation in Captures and Kass learns from it.

formatting.title: Formatting by voice
formatting.description: Say “new line” or “new paragraph”, or dictate a list.

handsFree.title: Hands-free
handsFree.description: Tap your keys with Space to start, tap again to stop. For long thoughts.

commandMode.title: Command Mode and transforms
commandMode.description: Select text in any app, hold the command keys and say what to do with it.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Press ⌘K in Kass to search everything you’ve said or run a command.

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: Words dictated, speaking pace and time saved.

onboarding.title: Go through onboarding again
onboarding.description: Permissions, your microphone, your keys and a short practice run.

purpose.whisper: Turns your speech into a raw transcript.
purpose.qwen3: Cleans up your raw transcript: fillers, punctuation, self-corrections, and your writing style.

problems.title: Problems
problems.noDetails: No error details available. Try downloading again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Model
deleteDialog.body: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.sizeNote: This will free up {{size}} of disk space. The model will need to be re-downloaded if you want to use it again.

migrateDialog.title: Move models to new location?
migrateDialog.description: The server will shut down while models are being moved to the new folder. It will restart automatically once the migration is complete.

migrate.title: Moving models
migrate.offline: The server is offline while models are being moved.

toast.cancelFailedDescription: Could not cancel the download task.
toast.resetToDefault: Reset to default location. Restarting server…
toast.noModelsToMigrateDescription: Download at least one model before changing the storage location.

settings.title: Writing style
settings.description: Teach Kass how you write so dictation comes out ready to send, in your own words. Everything stays on this device.

calibrate.title: Teach Kass how you write in {{style}}
calibrate.description: Reply to a few messages the way you normally would, by voice or by typing. Kass learns from how you actually write.
calibrate.descriptionApps: Reply to a few messages like the ones you write in {{apps}}, by voice or by typing. Kass learns from how you actually write.

export.title: Export corrections
export.description: Save every correction you've made as a JSON file.

reset.title: Reset {{style}}
reset.description: Forget what {{style}} learned from your replies, the punctuation habits learned from them and from corrections, and its rules. Other styles keep theirs. Match my writing switches back to Standard.

recent.title: Recent corrections in {{style}}
recent.empty: No corrections yet. Use Teach Kass on a capture to fix what it got wrong.

examples.title: Your examples
examples.description_one: {{count}} example of what you said and what you meant. Cleanup shows the most recent ones on every dictation.
examples.description_other: {{count}} examples of what you said and what you meant. Cleanup shows the most recent ones on every dictation.
examples.empty: No examples yet. Use Teach Kass on a capture, or teach this style above.
examples.dialogDescription: Cleanup shows the model your most recent examples. Older ones are summarized into rules. Removing an example stops Kass from using it.

notes.title: Rules from older examples
notes.description_one: {{count}} rule summarized from examples too old to show the model, so they keep counting.
notes.description_other: {{count}} rules summarized from examples too old to show the model, so they keep counting.
notes.empty: None yet. Once enough of your examples are older than the most recent ones, Kass summarizes them into rules while it's idle.
notes.dialogDescription: Cleanup follows these on every dictation. A new version is only kept when replaying your examples with it does no worse than the current rules.

summary.title: Here's what Kass learned
summary.noHabits: No punctuation habits beyond Standard yet.
summary.before: One of your dictations, cleaned up before
summary.after: Cleaned up with what you just taught

prompt.title: Make dictation write like you
prompt.description: Reply to a few messages the way you'd really send them, so Kass learns how you write. About 3 minutes.

styles.title: Styles and their apps
styles.description: Each style has its own punctuation and learns only from corrections made in its apps. Drag an app onto a style, or pick one in the list below. Click a style to filter the list and edit it.
styles.newHint: Starts with the default style's settings and nothing learned. Press Enter to add it.
styles.newNotice_one: {{count}} new app uses {{style}} until you pick a style.
styles.newNotice_other: {{count}} new apps use {{style}} until you pick a style.
styles.assignFailed: Could not change the app's style
styles.memory: Each style keeps its own model cache of about {{mb}} MB, which keeps switching apps fast. More styles use more memory.
styles.limit_one: Kass keeps at most {{count}} style, one model cache each.
styles.limit_other: Kass keeps at most {{count}} styles, one model cache each.

moveDialog.title: Move {{app}} to {{to}}
moveDialog.description_one: {{app}} has {{count}} correction teaching {{from}}. Bring it to {{to}}, or leave it with {{from}}? Either way, new corrections in {{app}} teach {{to}}.
moveDialog.description_other: {{app}} has {{count}} corrections teaching {{from}}. Bring them to {{to}}, or leave them with {{from}}? Either way, new corrections in {{app}} teach {{to}}.

settings.title: {{style}} settings
settings.name: Name
settings.punctuationDescription: How thoughts join and how the text ends. Match my writing follows the habits this style learned from you.
settings.defaultOn: Apps you haven't put in a style use this one.
settings.defaultDescription: Apps you haven't put in a style would use {{style}}.
settings.deleteDescription: Forgets what this style learned. Its apps move to the default style.
settings.descriptionHelp: In your own words: who you write to, how formal it is, and what's fine to skip. Kass follows it when it cleans up dictation in this style.
settings.descriptionPlaceholder: Mostly coworkers, so it's informal. Abbreviations like lmk are fine, run-on sentences are fine, no greetings or sign-offs…

habits.boundary_period: You end one thought and start the next as a new sentence
habits.boundary_comma: You join related thoughts with commas
habits.boundary_none: You run related thoughts together without punctuation
habits.drop_intro_comma: You skip the comma after opening words like "yeah" or "so"
habits.drop_conjunction_comma: You skip the comma before "and" or "but"
habits.drop_final_period: You leave off the final period

teach.title: Teach Kass how you write
teach.description: Reply to messages the way you normally would. Kass learns from what you send.
teach.finishNote_one: Saves your reply as an example.
teach.finishEmpty: Reply at least once to finish.
teach.subtitle: {{kind}} · {{relation}}
teach.wrapped: You wrapped up this conversation. Pick another one, or add a new one.
teach.replyPlaceholder: Dictate or type your reply, the way you'd really send it
teach.kindMenuNote: Picking one starts a new conversation of that kind. This one stays in the list.

design_feedback.label: Feedback on a design or change

change_of_mind.text: change your mind partway through, the way you would out loud.
change_of_mind.example: For example, start with one answer, say “no wait”, then give the real one. Kass should write only the real one.
change_of_mind.exampleWith: For example, say {{example}}. Kass should write only what you settled on.

long.text: take your time and explain, the way you'd talk it through.
long.example: It's fine to ramble; Kass learns how to put it in order.

summary.examples: Your dictated replies are saved as examples, and Kass uses them on your next dictations.
summary.typedOnly: You typed every reply, so Kass kept them but has no dictation to learn cleanup from. Dictate a few next time.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.description: Words dictation should get right, and phrases that write something for you. Pick where they apply on the left.

add.hint: Leave “When I say” empty to only teach the spelling.
add.limit: The dictionary is full at {{count}} words. Delete some to add more.

list.title: In {{scope}} · {{count}}
list.empty: A replacement writes one thing when you say another. A spelling-only word, with “When I say” left empty, is always spelled as written.
list.matchSound: Also fix words that sound like it
list.matchSoundHint: Off: only this exact spelling is fixed, so a similar name (Megan for Meghan) is left alone.

note.spokenFixHint: Added when you spelled it aloud to fix it. Only this exact spelling is fixed; words that sound like it are left alone.
note.exactHint: Only this exact spelling is fixed; words that sound like it are left alone.

inherited.title: Also applies in {{scope}}
inherited.dropped_one: {{count}} word doesn't fit in the speech model's prompt; it's still fixed after cleanup.
inherited.dropped_other: {{count}} words don't fit in the speech model's prompt; they're still fixed after cleanup.

phrases.hint: Type the phrase, click the mic, or hold <keys/> to say it. The text goes in exactly as written.
phrases.hintAnother: Click the mic or hold <keys/> to say it another way.
phrases.hintRelease: Let go of <keys/> to fill in the phrase.
phrases.hintTyped: Type what you say. The text goes in exactly as written.
phrases.empty: A phrase writes text for you when you say it: an email address, a link, a sign-off. Line breaks are kept.

appLocation.title: Move Kass to Applications
appLocation.description: Kass is running from {{path}}. macOS only keeps microphone, Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions working for an app in your Applications folder, so dictation may not work from here.
appLocation.replaces: The Kass already in Applications will be moved to the Trash.
appLocation.manual: Drag Kass into your Applications folder in Finder, then open it from there.

welcome.title: Talk. It writes.
welcome.body: You say the first thing. Kass sends the second. Everything stays on this Mac.

download.title: First, the models.
download.body: Two downloads. They keep going while you do the next steps, even if Kass has to restart.
download.diskTitle: Not enough space for the models.
download.diskBody: Free up about {{size}}, then check again.

failed.title: The download stopped.
failed.body: {{model}} stopped at {{percent}}%. Kass tried again a few times. Try once more, or use a smaller speech model that downloads faster. You can switch back later in Models.

inputMonitoring.title: Let your keys work in any app.
inputMonitoring.body: macOS calls this Input Monitoring. Kass only listens for the keys you use to dictate.
inputMonitoring.quitTitle: macOS will ask you to quit Kass.
inputMonitoring.quitBody: That’s expected. When it reopens, you’ll be right back here. Your downloads pick up where they left off.
inputMonitoring.onDetail: Kass came back right where you left off, and the downloads kept going.
inputMonitoring.holdHint: right side · hold the real keys
inputMonitoring.itWorks: It works. Kass heard your keys.

accessibility.title: Let your words land at your cursor.
accessibility.body: macOS calls this Accessibility. It lets Kass type into the app you’re using. No restart needed.
accessibility.onDetail: Text will show up wherever you’re typing.

microphone.title: Say hello.
microphone.askBody: First, let Kass use your microphone. Then talk and watch the bars move.
microphone.body: Talk and watch the bars. If they stay flat, pick a different microphone.
microphone.deniedBody: Kass can’t use the microphone. Turn it on in System Settings, then check again.
microphone.path: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone › Kass

keys.title: Hold these to talk.
keys.hint: Hold them in any app, talk, and let go. Add Space to talk hands-free. You can change your keys in Settings.
keys.needsInputMonitoring: Input Monitoring is off, so Kass can’t see your keys yet. Go back a few steps to turn it on.
keys.loginTitle: Open Kass when you log in
keys.loginDetail: So it’s ready whenever you are.

locked.title: Almost ready.
locked.body: {{model}} is still downloading. This step opens by itself as soon as it finishes.
locked.failedBody: The download stopped. Kass keeps trying, or you can fix it now.
locked.cantHear: Kass can’t hear you until this finishes.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.body: Hold your keys and say your name.
name.editBody: Type it the way you want it written. Kass will write it this way every time you say it.
name.saved: Saved to your dictionary, so it’s always spelled this way.
name.savedFixed: Saved to your dictionary. When you say it, Kass writes “{{name}}”.

messy.title: Say it the way you talk.
messy.body: Read this out loud, “um” and all.
messy.line: “Um, can we move lunch to noon? No, actually, one. At the usual place.”

style.body: Text {{persona}} back. Say it exactly how you would.
style.tell: Tell {{persona}}: {{facts}} Say it however you’d really say it.
style.checkTitle: Is this how you’d send it?
style.checkBody: If it’s not quite how you’d write it, edit it. Every change teaches Kass.
style.editBody: Change anything until it looks right. Every edit teaches Kass.
style.more: The more you reply, the more Kass sounds like you. Try a work message too: you probably write differently there.
style.moreLater: The more you reply, the more Kass sounds like you. Keep teaching it any time in Settings › Writing style.

rewrite.title: Fix text you already wrote.
rewrite.body: This is selected. Hold your command keys and say what to do with it, or pick one below.
rewrite.bodyNoKeys: This is selected. Pick what to do with it.
rewrite.paragraph: Hi team, I wanted to give a quick update on where things stand with the onboarding work. We have picked a direction for the flow and the next step is to design the screens, which should happen this week if nothing else comes up.

done.title: Go talk.
done.body: We’ll show you the rest when it’s useful.
done.push: Hold, talk, let go. Works in any app.
done.toggle: Hands-free. Tap to start, tap to stop.
done.change: Change any of these in Settings.

share.title: Share anonymous usage stats
share.body: Once a day: how many dictations, words, time saved and how fast they landed, plus your Mac's chip and which models you use. Never your words, your audio or the apps you dictate into. Change it any time in Settings › General.
